decision: NO-SHIP. BAND_SCALE_GUAR stays False; the flat band and the >2.5x disclosure stay served.
champion: flat band (unconditional deciles of the training log-guarantee residual pool)
challenger: location-scale band, fa_bands.fit on the restricted z, BAND_RIDGE_GUAR=3.0 fixed in advance

protocol.harness: tools/_fa_guarband.py chain() + a paired bootstrap on the same draws
protocol.control: BAND_PERMUTE_SEED per draw: the same estimator on a row-permuted residual column

primary_interval_calibration.rule: abs(cov_scale - 0.80) < abs(cov_flat - 0.80) by more than this run's MDE95

secondary_no_accuracy_regression.rule: guarantee and AAV MAE within the champion's MDE
secondary_no_accuracy_regression.note: Invariant by construction and verified numerically: the band writes only proj_guarantee_p10_usd / proj_guarantee_p90_usd and their AAV siblings. This criterion cannot fail, so it carries no evidence for the ship.

control_separation.rule: the permuted zero-information arm must not score as well as the candidate
control_separation.point_chain: the control is CLOSER to nominal coverage than the candidate (0.01818 vs 0.02235)
control_separation.bootstrap: the control improves by 0.00549 against the candidate's 0.00730, with an IDENTICAL p_improves of 0.775 and overlapping CI95

what_this_result_means: Two independent criteria say the signing corpus does not support a conditional variance function for the guarantee band. The fit does change the widths (ratio_sd 1.44 -> 2.74, p_improves 0.05, i.e. the widths reliably spread), but the spread does not land where the errors are: coverage-closeness moves less than the noise floor and a row-permuted residual column buys three quarters of the same movement. This is the second independent no-result on the same arm, after T1.2 (2026-07-25) on a pinball criterion. The band width is not a per-player quantity this corpus can estimate; the honest served treatment stays a flat band plus a stated disclosure.
do_not_re_run_without: a materially larger signing corpus, or a different conditioning set than fa_bands.GUAR_Z_NAMES. A ridge sweep over the existing arm is NOT a new experiment: it is a six-way search on a corpus that has now twice failed to separate from its own permutation.
